raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.9.1"
  # a known-not-minimum python
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  # remove undiscoverable tests
  unlink_tests: test_check_release.py
  # skip tests of repo files
  pytest_k: |-
    not (cmake_and_setuptools_source_lists_parity or version_matches)

package:
  name: wcwidth
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/w/wcwidth/wcwidth-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5823209b0d43af322ce698c689380d7c15ca31fa8e6e3be8459f27031bef0af5

build:
  number: 3
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    env:
      # makes the C extension mandatory instead of silently falling back to pure Python
      CIBUILDWHEEL: "1"
    content:
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --check-build-dependencies

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - crossenv
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools >=61
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - python-abi3
  run:
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - python-abi3

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      files:
        - etc/conda/test-files/wcwidth/**
      site_packages:
        - wcwidth/**
        - wcwidth-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
  - python:
      imports:
        - wcwidth
        - wcwidth._wcwidth_c
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
          else:
            - "*"
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/**
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - abi3audit
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - python -c "import os; [os.unlink(f'tests/{p}') for p in '''${{ unlink_tests }}'''.split()]"
      - pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes -k "${{ pytest_k }}"
      - if: is_abi3
        then:
          - if: unix
            then: abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} "${SP_DIR}/wcwidth/_wcwidth_c.abi3.so"
            else: abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} "%SP_DIR%/wcwidth/_wcwidth_c.pyd"

about:
  summary: Measures the displayed width of unicode strings in a terminal
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/wcwidth
  repository: https://github.com/jquast/wcwidth

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ocefpaf
    - timkpaine
